question: A, B, C, D, X and Y each scored different marks. Only two people have scored more than A. Only B has scored less than D. X has scored more than Y but less than C. How many people have scored more than X?
solution:
A, B, C, D, X and Y each scored different marks. Only two people have scored more than A. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7671c9a76bc3cf5ab80afc7bcd24bee3ea520bb2d1b0e8ad28c892dc314e9ee5.png] 

Only B has scored less than D. X has scored more than Y but less than C. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c42dc72c007855bc7f37e9b4ab4c59b7835d61d109ecbdea3cdb6702161645a.png] 

Only one people have scored more than X is C

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__ **

When it is stated that 'Only B has scored less than D', it mathematically means every other person (A, C, X, Y) must have scored more than D. This places B at the 6th position and D at the 5th. 

Combining this with other clues, 

Thus, the order is C > X > A > Y > D > B.
